name: tagout
description: Complete, verified, easy and fast upgrades of legacy .NET applications, powered by RoselineMCP (Roslyn) — a gate-verified pipeline from assessment to verified production — plus generic GitHub issue/PR lifecycle skills (create-issue, implement-issue, merge-pr) parameterized by a per-repo profile.

interface.shortDescription: Gate-verified .NET migrations and a hands-off issue-to-PR loop
interface.longDescription: Takes a legacy .NET application to verified production through seven gated phases, with RoselineMCP doing every C# analysis and edit, and takes a GitHub issue to a merged pull request hands-off.
defaultPrompt: Assess this legacy .NET solution for a migration.
Land PR #42 once its CI is green.
